reading_rule.entity: BOCPD all native input columns; NS all native triggering columns; exact native-column-to-existing-workload-entity prefix match only; root labels never choose channels
reading_rule.controls: Only frozen first-pre/first-post and frozen nearest no-alarm controls; frozen cross-case group selection and factorial branches unchanged. Missing control retained.
reading_rule.supported_or_refuted: Same full X, different CP refutes necessity of current-X change. Same x, changed native/fixed flags supports history bundle effect. Current X and state both different do not isolate either. Trace/log/load co-occurrence remains descriptive.
physical_limits: No validated clean-negative/onset or independent operational outcome
Workload unit/window, trace raw duration unit, completeness and exact event alignment unresolved
All quantities retrieved from locked observations; no claims for unsampled intervals

R1.interpretation: The inferred MAP segment start is not physical onset, not an alternative P3 metric, and not proof of incident relevance.

R2.limits: Prefix preprocessing still looks ahead inside the prefix. Mask/d/prior is a bundle. Signed first-CP shift is undefined if either branch has no CP.

step7.control_direction_limit: A later locked no-alarm control is valid for checking the inequality, not a pre-alarm negative or a temporal causal contrast. Names mean control vs alarm, never assume before vs after.

input_repetition_full.population: All 30 native full BOCPD series, all input columns, every current row i>=1 with previous row i-1 exactly one second earlier. No proxy cut, locked-point subsampling, root or graph entity selection.
input_repetition_full.input_semantics: Saved processed X actually consumed by native BOCPD. Exact elementwise equality, no tolerance, missing or nonfinite not counted as repeated; all processed X finite here.

denominators.CP: All saved CP_flags true at i>=1; first sentinel excluded and verified false; native abs(diff(m))>1 checked.
denominators.background_seconds: All valid adjacent-row seconds i>=1 across all cases; include both CP and no-CP seconds; full-X repetition requires all native columns equal.
denominators.cell_repeat: All adjacent time-by-native-column pairs in each case; pooled sums weighted by actual case dimension; not mean case percentage.

claude_comparison.interpretation: Exact counts compared exactly; rounded rates at precision reviewer reported. No significance/enrichment inference.

staircase_effect.could_be_false: Repetition may merely reflect normal sampling/aggregation; observed CP overlap close to background does not establish an effect.
staircase_effect.why_not_tested_in_T033: Minh explicitly forbids effect experiments in T033; no interventions or detector reruns authorized.
staircase_effect.dependent_decision: P6 choice of time resolution, observation weighting or input handling; none selected here.
